classification: READONLY source/design review; proposed slices, no implementation or runtime qualification
verdict: A real native metadata CLI and authenticated OLD/image-frame RPCs exist. The integrated source does not yet attach those components into an automatic native 4-to-5 relocation controller. It also lacks a Registered image-to-joint-NEW/first-Serving bridge and remote joint phase adapters. Existing generic balanced-controller APIs cannot bypass the native data quorum/fencing contract.

implemented_entry_map.actual: Builds a generic ClusterSupervisor + CapacityPlacement and TransportClusterRelocationDriver<TcpClusterRelocationTransport>. Balanced defaults: 250 ms, four steps/tick, four replica moves/two per node. Generic snapshot/catch-up/promotion/cleanup exists.
implemented_entry_map.boundary: This is not NativeMetadataControlHost and does not drive Registered A ownership or native joint phases. Native listeners deliberately refuse generic snapshot/import/repair/cleanup. Do not attach a second generic store or claim this old driver completes native relocation.

implemented_entry_map.actual: Retains the actual fresh factory, native metadata launch, listener, control and supervisor. OpenInitialData installs the real INITIAL writer/runtime and published Event Append/Get/typed Strong dispatcher after local leader readiness. CLI process loop maintains metadata enrollment and refreshes the initial writer registry.
implemented_entry_map.boundary: Fresh-only owner. No normal SQL listener is started by this command. No native relocation-maintenance action/loop is present.

implemented_entry_map.stage: fifth metadata node and replica receiver
implemented_entry_map.actual: Real CONFIG registration, native learner birth/catch-up, quorum promotion and owned receiver use mutual TLS and protected StoreUUID/birth. RegisteredReplica remains APP/Strong closed.
implemented_entry_map.boundary: Enrollment/promotion is metadata capacity, not materialized data or first writer policy. The learner CLI supports metadata/status/receiver lifecycle, not native image work.

implemented_entry_map.actual: Production TCP variants Constrain/Close/Observe obtain actual authenticated caller, receiver-local fresh role/OWN outside engine locks and retained original native OLD closure. Client validates original request, TLS/native birth, plan/scope and all returned constraints.
implemented_entry_map.boundary: Source-side only INITIAL admission in this source. Observe does not create a closure. Close initiation remains restricted by the actual recovery-purpose contract. The controller must request/retain real closures before asking the donor collector to collect.

implemented_entry_map.actual: Actual donor rereads every OLD peer via authenticated Observe, takes final fresh OWN after frame collection, preserves commands/pending obligations, and retains real capture/session before publication. Original process/session custody is distinct from bounded RPC requests.
implemented_entry_map.boundary: These APIs are crate-local; their callers outside their definitions are fixtures, not the operator process loop. No start/lookup RPC exposes this process-owned producer.

implemented_entry_map.actual: Manifest/History/Rows/Finish fetches use real pinned mutual TLS, actual native destination and current independently acquired source/target OWN. from_actual_manifest creates an immutable target-local NativeRemoteImageFact only from an actual authenticated Manifest exchange.
implemented_entry_map.boundary: The client requires a complete expected manifest including its checksum/session in order to request Manifest. This is fetch-after-discovery, not a start/discovery API. Do not use an invented empty/hash-zero manifest or deserialize a RemoteFact.

implemented_entry_map.actual: Original receiver retains per-range A attempt, exact MF Arc, actual runtime freeze rotation, proposal/Installing intent and outcomes before writes. History, rows, independent target scan, final native publication, native base and catalogue-floor adoption have actual producers. Each new request independently checks role/OWN/MStore and original local owner.
implemented_entry_map.boundary: Only fixture callers drive these image operations. Target image work ends at a still-CLOSED CatalogueFloor. No automatic source-requestor/work-queue API exists in NativeMetadataHost or NativeMetadataLearnerHost.

implemented_entry_map.actual: Typed OLD/NEW materialization, both-data-majority decision (new leader included), actual preparation/activation/Open/release and post-quorum writer-policy gates exist. They use actual in-process service/owner objects. Fresh phases preserve ALL final participants; they do not replace missing local state with Ready DTOs.
implemented_entry_map.boundary: Target NEW requires ActualServiceNativeJointNewEvidence backed by existing NativeImageCatalogueFinalization. NativeJointServingLease has Survivor or local Image only. The Registered remote final/base/catalogue + retained A has no corresponding NEW/lease/phase producer at this head. into_new_serving_owners returns foreign service Arcs, which cannot be implemented by serializing them across processes.

implemented_entry_map.actual: Existing INITIAL Event Append/Get/Strong data plane has genuine routing and enrolled quorum/recovered-epoch checks; strong reads do not fall through to bare local absence.
implemented_entry_map.boundary: Registered and AssignedClosed listener modes remain closed and immutable. A valid image or joint metadata stage cannot publish this data plane. New target requires actual completed first writer enrollment and normal recovered/read quorum before APP; every Strong still needs its own request-bound proof.

missing_attachment_map.exact_need: Add an owned NativeMetadataHost/NativeMetadataLearnerHost relocation-maintenance entry, or a process-owned worker created by those actual owners. Reuse the pure CapacityPlacement/build_failure_repair_plan policy and topology validators; add native typed MStore proposal adapters for learner allocation, decision certification, frozen promotion/final membership, activation/cleanup. Use actual current leader OWN + protected same-open actor/publication-version point at each local mutation. Commit through existing metadata consensus and publish only committed topology.
missing_attachment_map.do_not: Do not reopen a generic DistributionStore beside the owned native MStore, or treat a calculated candidate/decoded topology as data authority. DistributionStore::require_legacy_relocation_mutation expressly refuses enforced native membership/cleanup.

missing_attachment_map.exact_need: Wire authenticated node heartbeat/capacity/used-byte observations into the owned native metadata control loop, with incarnation/certificate fencing and bounded coalescing. The generic planner relies on ClusterNode.last_heartbeat_ms/capacity/used_bytes. NativeMetadataSupervisor/control.heartbeat perform metadata Append consensus, not the generic distribution heartbeat/capacity publication.
missing_attachment_map.scope: This is an attachment requirement for a future native planner, not evidence that the current metadata-only supervisor is broken.

missing_attachment_map.exact_need: Add a distinct bounded authenticated StartOrDescribeNativeImageSource request keyed by actual committed relocation/session/nonce + target birth + stable target attempt. Recipient re-derives actual local donor role/OWN/plan, checks actual retained native OLD closure, collects authenticated OLD facts at the donor, and retains NativeRetainedRemoteImageSource BEFORE attempting capture/publication. Reply returns only immutable manifest DATA and exact retained attempt status. Client validates actual TLS/native destination and every plan/birth/request binding before minting the authenticated Manifest wrapper. Lost replies return/reconcile the same retained session, never a new birth/attempt.
missing_attachment_map.do_not: No DTO -> local lineage/capture/quorum grant; no hash-zero expected manifest bootstrap. A target can request data but must not acquire metadata/range-leader initiator authority by making this request.

missing_attachment_map.missing: Target-process pull/requestor and per-range operation queue
missing_attachment_map.exact_need: Owned target worker obtains fresh actual target-role witness and target OWN outside engine/service/table locks, requests authenticated frames, creates the target-local RemoteFact through from_actual_manifest, and retains the same MF/A installation. It invokes existing proposal/Installing/history/row/verification/final/base/catalogue methods as bounded steps. On retry it obtains a new request from retained A; it never reconstructs NoDomain after a proposal or retags expired role/frame authority. Preserve unknown outcomes and cursor/intents before returning status.
missing_attachment_map.boundary: A local target worker can drive image mutation directly; it does not require a network endpoint that grants arbitrary row writes.

missing_attachment_map.missing: Registered image -> NEW/decision/first writer local bridge
missing_attachment_map.exact_need: Add a distinct typed Registered phase origin and lease bound to original receiver, retained A, actual native base/final/current+archive/catalogue, local slot/open and current MStore. Produce actual NEW materialization and exact decision candidate/xid/outcome before native writes; continue preparation/activation/Open/release through this distinct owner. First writer policy must consume ALL released final members and independently fresh post-quorum metadata. Retain installed real State/guard before fallible postchecks, then obtain ordinary enrolled read quorum/recovered coordinator before APP.
missing_attachment_map.do_not: Do not cast RemoteFact into local SourceRangeImageLineage or force the Registered record into the existing local Image lease. The separate driver WIP is outside this reviewed source; its existence is not evidence of this bridge here.

missing_attachment_map.missing: Authenticated joint-phase RPC producers, verifiers and collectors
missing_attachment_map.exact_need: Extend ClusterDataRequest/Response with bounded phase operations such as ObserveNew, Publish/ObserveDecision, PrepareServing, Activate/ObserveActivation, Arm/ObserveOpen, Release/ObserveReleased. Each handler receives DATA and authenticated peer identity, acquires fresh actual recipient role/OWN, consumes its retained local phase owner under exact original scopes and current MStore point, retains candidate/native xid/outcome before I/O, and returns request-correlated immutable facts. Dedicated client wrappers require the real TLS exchange; remote quorum collectors preserve complete old/new membership, command obligations, original request tokens and independent post-quorum checks.
missing_attachment_map.do_not: Existing PrepareNativeReady/CompleteNativeRecovery/ObserveCurrentNativeRange concern normal recovery and cannot be counted as joint NEW/decision/Open/release votes. Never serialize local Arc/service/freeze/lease capabilities or construct them from a checksummed reply.

missing_attachment_map.exact_need: After proven activated/Open/released final membership, add typed source export-pin/OLD owner retirement and range-scoped physical deletion/tombstone/empty audit, then metadata AwaitingCleanup -> Cleaned. Retain exact deletion progress and uncertain outcomes. New source-session retirement must require those proofs before removing registry entries or freeing physical pins. Report membership/leader/data balance separately from completion and only count a relocation converged after actual cleanup obligations finish.
missing_attachment_map.evidence: NativeJointHandoffStageV1 names AwaitingCleanup/Cleaned and validates their proof fields, but this source has no producer that advances those fields; current native methods stop at AwaitingActivation. NativeRemoteImageSourceRegistry retains a maximum of eight sessions and has no removal/retirement API. Generic cleanup is refused by native listeners.

missing_attachment_map.exact_need: Create an explicit actual Serving listener/dispatcher publication from the real completed local owner; do not broaden an old Registered or AssignedClosed listener through a mutable boolean/Weak upgrade. Status must expose replica-ready, leader-ready and strong-read-ready independently plus actual phase, range/epoch, pending native outcomes and last bounded error. Existing EventClient may handle physical range routing; ordinary pgwire remains a separate integration problem.

scheduling_checkpoint_and_failure_rules: One retained operation per selected range/session; fair bounded queue across ranges/nodes with explicit concurrency/byte limits and backoff. Subsequent attempts use new independent finite request authority, not longer TTLs or a recursive retry loop inside one request.

Network/role/OWN acquisition and remote collection happen outside engine, service, journal and table locks. Last local mutation publication still requires an actual current MStore/version point; a same-open identity or prior successful check is not freshness.

All ambiguous native proposal/base/catalogue/row outcomes retain the same original candidate/xid/bytes. Retire/retry only under the exact proven-abort contract; unknown/committed/poisoned/reopened owners cannot become a fresh transaction.

Existing auto_checkpoint_if_due is already called after Registered mutation scopes drop, and normal commit/checkpoint paths exist. Preserve actual same-open WAL pins and restrictive durable row index: the controller must not trim them to make progress. A five-second protocol deadline does not bound a stalled kernel fsync.

Fair queuing alone cannot establish independent-range availability: current Registered mutation paths hold a service guard and native journal across durable I/O. A deterministic stalled-I/O test must prove other range APP/Strong/control operations progress or keep that availability gate open.
Lost source-session reply, source death and target restart are separate cases. Preserve durable closure/pending debt; do not clear a fence or recreate a factory because the initiating RPC ended.

minimum_independent_slices.slice: S1 native planning and truthful status
minimum_independent_slices.acceptance: Five actual native CLI processes: fifth joins automatically; current leader produces a bounded committed learner plan from authenticated current capacity/liveness. All affected data remains closed until later producers prove readiness. No external test controller edits topology or shard placement.

minimum_independent_slices.slice: S2 real donor start/discovery plus target pull to CLOSED catalogue floor
minimum_independent_slices.acceptance: Separate donor/target OS processes and real TLS only. Start/Describe retry returns the same actual session/MF, and target progresses through history/rows/independent verification/final/base/catalogue using its own retained A and fresh per-step requests. Wrong donor/target/birth/scope, revoked process/hook/MStore and reply cancellation refuse without new attempts. No Serving claim.

minimum_independent_slices.slice: S3 local Registered joint bridge, then network joint phase adapters
minimum_independent_slices.acceptance: First complete a genuine local registered owner bridge, then replace every foreign service Arc in multi-member collection with actual authenticated phase exchanges while retaining local owners on their recipient processes. Preserve old local tests. Qualify both OLD/NEW decision majorities and complete final participant preparation/Open/release with fresh post-quorum authority; test lost replies at each native/catalogue boundary.

minimum_independent_slices.slice: S4 first actual APP and Strong, then a populated second range
minimum_independent_slices.acceptance: After ALL-release + first policy, obtain ordinary readiness, return a real APP ACK and full Strong read from unchanged EventClient. Only then move a second already-populated range onto the same node using original installed State/coordinator/hook and selected-range ownership. Preserve first range ACKs and read consistency. Two closed images or two empty ranges do not pass.

minimum_independent_slices.slice: S5 source retirement and converged placement
minimum_independent_slices.acceptance: Prove typed pin retirement, actual source tombstone/empty-range audit, no stale writer, restored RF/placement, no unfinished relocation, leadership serving actual work and stable physical-byte redistribution. More than eight completed serial moves must not exhaust leaked session custody; no timeout eviction.

Kill/restart each actual node process at proposal, row intent/WAL/applied-progress, final/base/catalogue, decision/Open/release/policy and source cleanup boundaries. Recover from protected native decisions/archives and independently current metadata without reconstructing grants from DATA. Cold pending rows currently refuse before generic replay/cut; implement and test their explicit repair path separately. Preserve exact unknown outcomes.

Pinned release binary on isolated independent VMs/failure domains with separately durable external ledger. Unchanged client workload, automatic movement, actual faults, all ACK/uncertain/failed/retry operations reconciled, zero false absence and no lost ACKs. Compare four-node steady state against fully converged five-node steady state at the same latency/error budget. Relocation throughput and post-convergence throughput are distinct. Original Azure failure remains preserved.

distinct_gates.startup: INITIAL native operator is fresh-only. Existing learner reopen is metadata-only: NativeColdLearnerMetadataHost explicitly supports both an enrolled metadata learner and an already Registered metadata voter, but the factory/current context still requires no data-range assignment. It is not a persisted INITIAL/Assigned data-owner restart path. Ordinary serve does not substitute for the original native process owner.
distinct_gates.second_populated_range: Registered image methods explicitly reject self.assigned.is_some() or self.data.is_some(). SAME-State writer DATA continuation primitives preserve actual installed State, but do not by themselves provide an Assigned image target or a normal operator/controller source/target surface. A real populated move after first Serving/ACK/Strong is mandatory.
distinct_gates.cold: No reopening raw forensic copies. Main500 plain physical-root copies are refused; use the official stopped-copy custody authorization when intentionally restoring. That authorization is neither source retirement nor node/range authority. Current pending-row startup preservation is refusal, not completed repair/availability.
distinct_gates.general_SQL: Native CLI starts Event Append/Get and typed read surfaces, not arbitrary PostgreSQL execution. Initial native listener explicitly refuses scan/SQL/effects. RangeWriteCoordinator::resolve_range rejects cross-range write intents and nonleader local admission. No ordinary PostgreSQL gateway routing, general cross-range joins or recoverable multi-range SQL coordinator is established by the native move path.
distinct_gates.capacity: Capacity/replica/leader redistribution and request-load balancing are separate. Start with existing bounded placement and prove one relocation converges; resource telemetry or later hotspot policy must not be presented as throughput gain. No physical results were run in this review.
